answer: The Registered domain bound by attestation certificate with annual re-verification makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Even a quiet velvet gets heard, because binding weighs evidence, not volume. A garden alone is noise; a sonnet of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
